verdict.rationale: Increase documents ACH origination via `POST /ach_transfers`. Its docs cover same-day ACH debits as well as credits, submission at all three same-day Fed windows, and webhooks for each step of the transfer lifecycle (Ramp case study). ACH returns are automatically correlated with their originating transfers, and sandbox simulations cover ACH events. Missing for 10: any evidence of Notifications of Change (NOCs) or reversals as modeled objects, explicit docs showing returns as standalone first-class API objects with dedicated webhook event types, and independent hands-on corroboration beyond vendor material.
